note: 🔴 REQ-112 §R — THE THREE-TRIGGER MODEL (T1 pre-start declaration · T2 coach's leave · T3 school cancel with SCHOOL_ISSUE; an ordinary leave adds NOTHING). T1a/T1b/T2a/T3a/T3b each remove ONE trigger's call and each must bite ALONE — which is the proof the list is complete and each is reachable. O1/O2 put the helper back on an ORDINARY leave (the first, wrong model). P1 is the 'whose fault' predicate replacing the list — it reads right and gets T1 BACKWARDS, so a pre-start declaration earns nothing and an ordinary leave earns a week. E1 lets ADMIN_ERROR earn at door 4; E2 reads the free-text note; E3 drops the same-slot rule; E4 drops ATTENDED; E5 drops the live/ATTENDED guard (a re-cancel earns twice); E6 stores EVERY code on a course cancel (no longer byte-identical). X1 adds a fourth trigger to the list. W1/W2 the arithmetic and the +14 risk; L1 re-introduces LEAVE_LOCKED and L2 makes `leaveLocked` true again; S1 restores stretch-to-fit; C1/C2 make the plan editor charge a pre-start leave; R1/R2 the atomicity and the actor; F1 forward-only; G1 the counter charging a declared day; I1/I2 the re-mark defects found by value tests. 🔻 This set REPLACES `every-leave-adds-a-week-task656.mutations.json` (the first, wrong model); its ids D1–D5 are retired with it.
